units: Cant. R. to VI, 11, v. שְׂחוֹק; (Pesik. R. s. 11 תענוג).—Pl. שַׁעֲשׁוּעִים. Tanḥ. T’tsavveh 1; Yalk. Jer. 315 ילד של ש׳ a child of delight, v. שָׁעַע.—Trnsf. (sub. ילד, ילדי) beloved child or children.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:12">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> (in a eulogy) <he>ארץ … גידלה שַׁעֲשׁוּעֶיהָ</he> the land of Shinear (Babylonia) conceived and gave birth to, the land of beauty (Palestine) raised her beloved child.
